findings.message: Remove literal backslashes from the generated binary lookup. In this unquoted heredoc, `\"` survives into the generated probe, producing `command -v \"jq\"` rather than `command -v "jq"`. The remote shell therefore searches for a binary whose name includes literal double quotes. Since `jq` is the first manifest entry, every GCE verification fails with `missing_binary:jq`, even for healthy deployments. Emit ordinary double quotes around the binary name instead.
